blockProperties.name: AspectRatio
blockProperties.description: Returns the Aspect ratio of the screen.

blockProperties.name: Density
blockProperties.description: Returns the density of the display. This is a scaling factor for the Density Independent Pixel (DP), also known as device-independent-pixels (DIP).

blockProperties.name: DensityDeviceStable
blockProperties.description: Stable density. This value is constant at run time and may not reflect the current display density. To obtain the current density for a specific display, use DensityDpi function instand of this.

blockProperties.name: DensityDpi
blockProperties.description: Returns the screen density as dots-per-inch.

blockProperties.name: FontScale
blockProperties.description: Current user preference for the scaling factor for fonts, relative to the base density scaling. Returns values between 0.8 and 2.0. Default fontScale = 1

blockProperties.name: HeightCm
blockProperties.description: Returns the height of the screen size in cm.

blockProperties.name: HeightDP
blockProperties.description: Returns density-independent-pixels (DP) of the screen hight, also known as device-independent-pixels (DIP).

blockProperties.name: HeightInch
blockProperties.description: Returns the height of the screen size in Inch.

blockProperties.name: HeightMm
blockProperties.description: Returns the height of the screen size in mm.

blockProperties.name: HeightPixels
blockProperties.description: Returns the absolute hight of display size in pixels (px).

blockProperties.name: ScaledDensity
blockProperties.description: A scaling factor for fonts displayed on the display. This is the same as density, except that it may be adjusted in smaller increments at runtime based on a user preference for the font size.

blockProperties.name: WidthCm
blockProperties.description: Returns the width of the display size in cm.

blockProperties.name: WidthDP
blockProperties.description: Returns density-independent-pixels (DP) of the screen width, also known as device-independent-pixels (DIP).

blockProperties.name: WidthInch
blockProperties.description: Returns the width of the display size in Inch.

blockProperties.name: WidthMm
blockProperties.description: Returns the width of the display size in mm.

blockProperties.name: WidthPixels
blockProperties.description: Returns the absolute width of display size in pixels (px).

blockProperties.name: Xdpi
blockProperties.description: The physical pixels per inch of the screen in the X dimension.

blockProperties.name: Ydpi
blockProperties.description: The physical pixels per inch of the screen in the Y dimension.
